title: kernel-v1 supported-load envelope (v1)
description: Published maximum sustained event rate per CPU that the platform promises to deliver with zero critical synthetic fixture loss under normal supported-load conditions. Saturation above this rate is expected to drop events, NOT to silently pass.

default_rate_events_per_sec_per_cpu.description: Maximum sustained event rate per CPU under which the platform promises zero critical synthetic fixture loss under normal supported-load conditions.

tiny_ring_size_bytes.description: Ring buffer size used by the saturation fixture harness; powers of two only.

sample_duration_seconds.description: Duration in seconds of each saturation sample.

saturation_sanity_cpu_count.description: Number of CPUs to fan out during the saturation test.
